assertions.check: Headline communicates the core value proposition in under 10 words
Subheadline explains what the product does for whom
At least one clear CTA (call-to-action) is present with specific action text
Copy addresses the ICP's primary pain point from context/ideal-customer.md
Features section uses benefits language (what the user gets) not feature language (what the product has)
Social proof section is planned (even if placeholder for testimonials/logos)

meta_assertion: Would the target ICP understand what this product does and want to try it within 10 seconds of landing on this page?
test_prompt: Write landing page copy for a developer deployment automation tool.
